test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: On investing an amount of 7.5% simple interest per annum, it becomes Rs. 819 after completion of 4 years. What was the amount invested?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate(R)% = 7.5%

Time(T) = 4 years

Amount = Rs. 819

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal(P) + Simple interest(S.I) 

Amount = P(1 + RT/100)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

simple interest(S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + S.I

⇒ P + PRT/100

⇒ Amount = P(1 + RT/100)

⇒ 819
